579	A rosh yeshiva who passed away at age 94.
580	He had
581	350 students in the yeshiva.
582	He ruled the whole yeshiva, led the
583	yeshiva with a strong hand.
584	At 94, every day he gave a lesson standing up,
585	two hours every day, including Friday, including Shabbat, every day.
586	I studied there for 95 years, we never saw him
587	sick. You see young guys of 19, 18:
588	where were you? I didn't feel well. And the rosh yeshiva, at
589	90, has no "I don't feel well."
590	Every day he got up at five in the morning,
591	opened the gates of the yeshiva, this was in Tel Aviv,
592	and went out for a one-hour walk.
